name: NEMO x402 Micro-Services
description: Twenty-four pay-per-call agent micro-services, listed in the catalogue at agentx.sale and settled on-chain via x402 (USDC on Base) or the IETF Machine Payments Protocol (stablecoin via the Coinbase facilitator; card payments via Stripe on $1+ routes): weather, site health & SEO, crypto ticker / gas / Fear&Greed, the full Polymarket toolkit (trending, odds, order book, history, resolution watch, arb scan), email deliverability, FX rates, Bitcoin fees, WebMCP tools, and an x402 Doctor spec-check.
